snippet.title: TrackRush – Pixel Time-Trial Racing | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Race the clock in TrackRush, a pixel-art time-trial racer you play free in your browser. No download, no install.

🏁 Play now: https://trackrush-game.xyz
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/VG9uG5Vkn9

Drift through banked corners for a speed kick, hit loops, big jumps and drops, and hunt down the hidden shortcuts. Race your own ghost to earn bronze, silver, gold and Rush medals across 25 hand-built maps, from desert canyons to snowy night circuits.

Sign in with Discord to race Ranked: every map has its own leaderboard, and your season rating climbs from Rookie to Legend.

Build your own maps in the Map Editor and share them as Community Maps, sorted into categories: Circuit, Precision, Full Send, Gauntlet, Playground and Quickfire. Every community map has its own leaderboard, and you can race the record holder's ghost.

Works with keyboard or controller.

#TrackRush #RacingGame #PixelArt #IndieGame #BrowserGame
